item.title: Compute brief — 8 September 2026
item.description: Today’s conversion lead is Southeast Asia, not the rental book. Firmus announced a multi-year deal for OpenAI to take dedicated capacity at two Malaysia AI Factory sites — pushing Firmus’ contracted portfolio above 900 MW across seven factories in Australia, Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia, with Vera Rubin NVL72 via NVIDIA DSX + HyperCube. Separately, MISO’s Aug 28 FERC filing (ER26-3650) puts Midcontinent large loads (>50 MW; computational loads ≥25 MW IT) under proposed visibility, PMU, ramp and ride-through rules with a Dec 4 effective ask. The Silicon Tape is another confirm morning: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged; the only list tick is CoreWeave L40S spot $0.99→$0.98. Countries: Malaysia: Firmus–OpenAI (8 Sep): two Malaysia AI Factory sites; OpenAI anchor; Firmus contracted capacity >900 MW portfolio-wide. Site MW and contract $ undisclosed; power/water scrutiny remains the local constraint. United States / MISO: MISO IRR tariff at FERC ER26-3650 (filed 28 Aug): >50 MW large loads; ≥25 MW IT computational loads; Dec 4 effective ask; more filings by Nov 16. Howard–Solstice 59336 still HOLD. India / Telangana: TCS HyperVault (5 Sep) still the live India campus print: 264 acres Hyderabad, up to 1 GW, ≤₹70,000 crore with partners; June 2028 inauguration ask. PPA/EPC/offtake unpublished.
